figures.finding: In the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina the Cinematography Foundation Sarajevo (founded 2002 by the Federation government, under its Ministry of Culture and Sports) co-finances film projects through competitions, the first of five planned for 2025 announced after a review of its procedures; from 2026 a separate Sarajevo Canton film foundation has BAM 2.5 million from the canton's budget.

funds.name: Fondacija za kinematografiju Sarajevo (Cinematography Foundation Sarajevo)
funds.by: Government of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina

figures.applies: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (not Republika Srpska), 2025-2026.

sources.said: The Cinematography Foundation Sarajevo was founded in 2002 by the Government of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and works under the auspices of the Ministry of culture and Sports of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

The Cinematography Foundation Sarajevo has announced a competition for the selection of beneficiaries of the Cinematography Foundation’s funds for co-financing film projects for 2025. This is the first of a total of five planned competitions that will be announced during the current year, in accordance with the spending programs adopted by the Government of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
For the 2026 fiscal year, the Sarajevo Canton Budget has allocated 2.5 million Bosnian marks (approximately €1.28 million) to fund the Foundation’s operations.

figures.finding: Sarajevo Canton's Ministry of Culture and Sports co-finances film under the canton's Law on Film Activity: 75% of the year's film budget goes to features over 60 minutes, 20% to shorts and 5% to drama-series development; a fiction feature may get KM 50,000 to 200,000, a feature documentary KM 30,000 to 100,000, a short KM 10,000 to 20,000, series development KM 5,000 to 10,000; only costs incurred in the canton count, with the production company's fee capped at 10%, contingency at 7% and co-authors' rights at 30% of the film's budget.

value.funder: Ministry of Culture and Sports, Canton Sarajevo
value.law: Zakon o filmskoj djelatnosti (Službene novine Kantona Sarajevo 07/01, 45/21)

figures.applies: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Canton Sarajevo (Federation), call instructions published September 2023.

sources.said: Sredstava Ministarstva namijenjena filmskoj produkciji će se za koristiti za produkciju projekta dugometražnih filmova, odnosno, filmova dužih od 60 minuta, i to u iznosu od 75% ukupnog budžeta planiranog za tekuću godinu. Za produkciju kratkometražnih filmova namijenjeno je 20% ukupnog budžeta planiranog za tekuću godinu. Za razvoj dramskih serija namijenjeno 5% budžeta planiranog za tekuću godinu. Iznos sredstava koja se mogu dodijeliti dugometražnim igranim filmovima iznosi u rasponu od 50.000,00 – 200.000,00 KM. Iznos sredstava koja se mogu dodijeliti dugometražnim dokumentarnim filmovima iznosi u rasponu od 30.000,00 – 100.000,00 KM.

Prihvatljivim troškovima se smatraju troškovi nastali u Kantonu Sarajevo … autorska prava koautora limitirani na 30% ukupnog budžeta filma … nepredviđeni troškovi limitirani na 7%, j) naknada produkcijskoj kući limitirana na 10%.
